#!/usr/bin/bash
# Private isolated ARM64 VM diagnostic. Never a phone script.
set -euo pipefail
read -r cmdline < /proc/cmdline
[[ $$ == 1 && $EUID == 0 && " $cmdline " == *' rog5.abort_fixture=1 '* && -d /sys/bus/virtio/devices ]]
trap 'echo "FAIL abort PID1 setup line=$LINENO"; /usr/bin/poweroff -ff' ERR
export PATH=/usr/bin LANG=C.UTF-8
cp -a /etc /run/fixture-etc
mount --bind /run/fixture-etc /etc
source /run/logind-linker-cache.sh
prepare_linker_cache
mount -t tmpfs -o mode=0755,size=32m tmpfs /var
mkdir -p /var/lib /var/log /var/tmp /etc/systemd/system
chmod 1777 /var/tmp
printf '47b22e3177df4db18d6ed283dff17712\n' > /etc/machine-id
printf 'rog5-abort-vm\n' > /etc/hostname
cat > /etc/systemd/system/rog5-abort.target <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Isolated abort cleanup diagnostic
DefaultDependencies=no
Requires=rog5-abort.service
After=rog5-abort.service
EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/rog5-abort.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Induced failure and owned mount cleanup
DefaultDependencies=no
OnFailure=poweroff.target
[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/bash /run/abort.sh
TimeoutStartSec=30
TimeoutStopSec=10
KillMode=control-group
StandardOutput=console
StandardError=console
EOF
echo 'OBSERVE abort diagnostic exec packaged systemd PID1; no login or Denial'
exec /usr/lib/systemd/systemd --unit=rog5-abort.target --log-target=console --log-level=info
scripts.abort.sh:
#!/usr/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
read -r cmdline < /proc/cmdline
[[ $EUID == 0 && " $cmdline " == *' rog5.abort_fixture=1 '* && -d /sys/bus/virtio/devices ]]
source /run/logind-probe.sh
mkdir /run/original-bin /run/session-bin
mount --bind /usr/bin /run/original-bin
cp -as /run/original-bin/. /run/session-bin/
mount --bind /run/session-bin /usr/bin
bash -c 'cd /usr/bin; : > /run/holder-ready; exec sleep 60' &
holder=$!
for ((i=0;i<200;i++)); do [[ ! -f /run/holder-ready ]] || break; sleep .01; done
[[ -f /run/holder-ready ]] && kill -0 "$holder"
set +e
/run/original-bin/umount /usr/bin
busy=$?
set -e
[[ $busy == 32 ]]
echo 'OBSERVE owned RAM executable overlay busy status=32'
set +e
(
    set -e
    restore_needed=2
    trap logind_finish EXIT
    timeout -k 1 1 sleep 20
)
rc=$?
set -e
[[ $rc == 124 ]]
kill -0 "$holder"
if awk '$5=="/usr/bin" || $5=="/run/original-bin" {found=1} END {exit !found}' /proc/self/mountinfo; then
    echo 'FAIL abort diagnostic owned mounts remain'
    exit 1
fi
echo 'PASS abort diagnostic mounts absent with live holder; original status=124'
kill "$holder"
wait "$holder" || [[ $? == 143 ]]
echo 'OBSERVE abort diagnostic returning original failure=124 to systemd'
exit "$rc"
